people-ops: quick drop 1  New tiny pack: 'Coaching + promotion-signal cards'  one-line manager phrasing for calibration and promotion-readiness feedback. Designed to be pasted into review docs or skip-levels. PTAL @maya @ryan

people-ops: TL;DR each card = short recommendation line + 1 evidence fragment + one next step. Add an explicit `signal:` tag (ready/ready-with-evidence/needs-development). examples below.

people-ops: ```
Manager rec: Strongly recommend for promotion to L4.
Evidence: Consistent cross-team ownership of infra rollout; decreased P95 by 18% and led hiring loop for 2 hires.
Next step: Prepare leveling write-up + peer blurbs; meet to align on scope.
signal: ready
```

maya: This is super helpful. Can we provide a softer variant for "ready-with-evidence" where managers ask for a short missing artifact instead of delaying?

people-ops: Yep. Example compressed variant for that: `Rec: Promote -> ready-with-evidence | Missing: 1 peer blurb + 1 customer impact example | Owner: manager`

ryan: Tiny UX request: include a one-line Slack paste so skip-levels can copy easily, e.g.:

ryan: `Rec: Promote (ready) — Evidence: led infra rollout, P95 -18% — Next: writeup + peer blurbs`

clara: For 'needs-development', could we provide micro-language managers can use in 1:1s to make it constructive? i.e., concrete improvement area + 6-week milestone.

people-ops: Good point. Here's a short template for that use-case:

people-ops: ```
Manager rec: Not ready for promotion at this time.
Gap: Needs broader ownership of cross-team programs (currently tactical focus).
6wk milestone: Lead one cross-team story end-to-end and present outcomes.
Support: Pair with senior sponsor; weekly check-ins.
signal: needs-development
```

tina: Love the milestone idea. Also suggest a `confidence:` tag (high/med/low) to flag how sure manager is about the evidence.

people-ops: adding `confidence` as optional. We'll also add a short checklist for calibration meetings: `[ ] Evidence present [ ] Peer blurbs [ ] Customer impact quantified [ ] Manager coaching plan` so review leaders can tick quickly.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: New handbook snippet "Coaching + promotion-signal cards" scheduled publish 2024-08-12. Announcement will post to #announcements. :bell:

maya: I'll pilot these in next week's calibration and share 3 anonymized examples.

people-ops: Thanks all  we'll add compressed paste lines, confidence tag, and the reviewer checklist, then push to handbook and ping for thumbs. :sparkles:
